description: Source code for a PHP class implementing a client-side browser version limitation plugin for ad delivery filtering, including methods for initialization, display, and input validation.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Client_BrowserVersion
classes.description: A plugin class for filtering ad delivery based on viewer's browser and version, extending a comma-separated data limitation class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin, setting up operations and browser list.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with data and sets the 'any version' operation label.

methods.name: displayArrayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML for selecting browser and version, with JavaScript for dynamic form behavior.

methods.name: _flattenData
methods.description: Ensures data array has a version element, defaults to empty string if missing.

methods.name: checkInputData
methods.description: Validates input data, ensuring version is numeric if provided.
